title: Great Tread Does Not Tell You the Tire's Birthday
topic: Tire age is separate from tread depth and can be read from the DOT date code
mechanicTruth: Tread depth and tire age measure different things; the final four digits of the DOT Tire Identification Number encode the week and year of manufacture, and age should be considered alongside condition and manufacturer guidance.
